responses.text: Julie represents the Followers of the Apocalypse. They're a group that tries to help people out whenever they can, so we get along just fine.
If you ever need to get patched up, one of their docs'll have you right as rain in no time flat. They sell supplies, too. Or used to.
Heard they were having trouble bringing stuff in, or keeping up with the demand, or something, lately.
Did you want to know about anyone else?

topics.prompt: Tell me about Julie Farkas.

responses.text: Them twins run the Atomic Wrangler, the only working casino here in Freeside. It's become pretty much {thee} the place to go around these parts.
Give it a whirl when you've got some time. Now, was there anyone else you wanted to know about?

topics.prompt: I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins.

responses.text: They're a family-run business from out west that deal in weapons mostly. A word of caution, though. They're not a friendly bunch. Not at all.
Their store is just past the Wrangler, and sells all kinds of fancy weapons that most people around here can't afford.
Anyone else you wanted to know about?

topics.prompt: Who are the Van Graffs?

responses.text: Mick and Ralph sell all sorts of things at a small store over by the east gate. They've done all right by us, and they'll do all right by you.
You want to know about anyone else?

topics.prompt: What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?

responses.text: I'll send some guys to check out your story, but that's some good news for a change.
Word will probably spread about this, and quickly. The NCR'll know not to come around these parts if they know what's good for 'em.
You've helped us plenty, so I'll tell you what. Just this once, name whatever you want, and if I can make it happen, it's done.
Don't rush it, though. Toss it around in your head a little. You only get one favor from The King.

topics.prompt: They were distributing supplies down by the old train station, but I dealt with them.

responses.text: {Overwhelmed by emotion} That's... that's terrible. I hope the poor little guy gave as good as he got. {Sad, but proud} He always was a fighter.
{Breaking down a little} Why I remember one time when he... {Tries to switch topics to cover} do you mind if we talk about something else?

topics.prompt: I hate to tell you this, but Rex is dead.

responses.text: I expect you to treat my Rexie with a little more care. I'm expecting him back now, you hear?
Now, was there something you wanted to talk about?

topics.prompt: You know, I really don't pay attention to him, so your guess is as good as mine.

responses.text: You're a man of your word, no doubt about it. I can't thank you enough.

topics.prompt: He sure did.

responses.text: No no, you can hold onto him for a little while longer, I think. You deserve that much at least, for what you've done.
But aside from the good news about my Rex, was there something you wanted?

topics.prompt: I don't have to give him back just yet, do I?

responses.text: Naw, I'm just happy to see my pup back on his feet and happy. I can't thank you enough for this.
Hopefully, he's been making himself useful as a way of paying you back. But where are my manners, did you need something?

topics.prompt: Should I leave you two alone?

responses.text: Okay, I need some answers, now. These guys just barged in here and said they were under orders to keep me here until you arrived.
I'm about five seconds away from telling my men to take them down, so speak fast.

topics.prompt: VMS29KingOfferStart

responses.text: Maybe you can tell me what the hell is going on here. These stony face bastards haven't said a word other than to say they're here under orders.

topics.prompt: VMS29KingUltimatumStart

responses.text: An ultimatum? Do you even know who you're talking to? We're the Kings, and no King will ever accept an ultimatum.
Go back to your general or commodore or whatever-the-fuck and tell them to shove their ultimatum where the sun don't shine.

topics.prompt: I'm here to deliver an ultimatum from the NCR. Cease hostilities against the NCR or perish.

responses.text: You know, it's that "or else" part that gets stuck in my craw. It just sounds a little too much like you're trying to tell us what to do.
And nobody tells the Kings what to do. So why don't you and all of your little friends get the hell out of here. Or else.

topics.prompt: The NCR wants you to curb the violence in Freeside. Or else.

responses.text: Well, Freeside citizens are also being attacked and I'd like you all to stop it, but I'm guessing that's not going to happen, is it?
This little show of force accomplishes nothing. So take your toy soldiers and go home. Show's over.

topics.prompt: NCR citizens are dying in Freeside and the NCR wants you to stop it.

responses.text: That sounds fair. And all I have to do is try to tone down the attacks on the Squatters, you say?

topics.prompt: I've been instructed to offer you more resources in exchange for your word that the violence stops.

responses.text: And I suppose they want me to help see that happen? That seems pretty reasonable.

topics.prompt: I apologize for their rudeness. The NCR wants peace in Freeside, and offers additional supplies.

responses.text: Sounds like a challenge. Boys, let's do this!

topics.prompt: Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men.

responses.text: All right. I'll see you later.
